issues.title: Update support center email address
issues.description:
**Description:** This PBI covers the work to update the email address for the Support Center on the SkyCast Home page. The Enterprise Services organization has been renamed to Business Unit 2, resulting in a new email address that must be reflected in the application.

---

### User Story

*   **As an** SkyCast user seeking assistance,
*   **I want** the correct, new email address for the Support Center on the Home page,
*   **so that** my support requests are sent to the proper destination and I can get help when I need it.

---

### Acceptance Criteria

#### **Scenario 1: Viewing the Help Page**

*   **Given** a user navigates to the "Help" page,
*   **When** the page loads,
*   **Then** the new email address, `support@business-unit-2.example.com`, **must** be the link behind the link text "Support".

#### **Scenario 2: Interacting with the Email Link**

*   **Given** the new email address is linked from the text "Support" on the home page,
*   **When** a user inspects the link,
*   **Then** the link **must** be a `mailto:` link pointing to `mailto:support@business-unit-2.example.com`.
*   **And when** a user clicks the link,
*   **Then** their default email client **must** open a new message pre-addressed to `support@business-unit-2.example.com`.
